description: Canonical chunk-framing vectors shared by the Android and iOS libraries. Each 'split' case feeds `message` through a fresh Chunker (so msgId starts at 0) with the given `maxChunkLength` (max bytes per write/notify, header included) and must produce exactly `chunks`. Each 'roundTrip' case splits `message` and feeds the chunks back through a fresh Reassembler, which must return `message` on the final chunk and null before. All byte values are 0-255. See the wire specification, 'MTU and chunking'.
